###---mC correlation between E9epi and E9te at diff genomic elements
```{r}
bigtable <- readRDS("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/EMseq_final_genome/DMRs_sperm_EPI_TE/bigtable/sperm_E9epi_E9te_bigtable.tsv")

CpG <- c(bigtable, ignore.mcols=TRUE)
values(CpG) <- as.data.frame(bigtable)[,-c(1:5)]  

col<-seq(1, ncol(mcols(CpG)), by=2)
names <- sub("\\.(C|cov)$", "", colnames(mcols(CpG))[col])
col <- setNames(col, names)
```


```{r}
genes <- fread("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/EMseq_final_genome/annotations/dunnart_male_T2T_genes.bed")
genes <- as.data.frame(genes)
genes_gr <- GRanges(seqnames=genes$V1, ranges=IRanges(start=genes$V2, end=genes$V3), strand=genes$V4, name=genes$V5)


genes_gr <- subsetByOverlaps(genes_gr, CpG)

av_meth <- mapply(function(a, b){overlapRatios(CpG, genes_gr, a, b, minCov=3)}, a = col, b = col+1) # calculates methylation ratio using .C and .cov of adjacent columns 
x<- as.data.frame(av_meth)
mcols(genes_gr) <- cbind(mcols(genes_gr), x)
genes_df <- as.data.frame(genes_gr)

x.na <- genes_df[complete.cases(genes_df),]

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
plot_data <- x.na %>%
  select(name, E9epi_r1, E9te_r1, sperm_r1, sperm_r2) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(E9epi_r1, E9te_r1, sperm_r1, sperm_r2),
               names_to = "Sample",
               values_to = "Methylation")

plot_data$Sample<-factor(plot_data$Sample, levels=c("sperm_r1", "sperm_r2", "E9epi_r1", "E9te_r1"))

setwd("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/EMseq_final_genome/annotations/figures/")
pdf("E9epi_E9te_genebody_methylation_boxplots.pdf", width = 7, height = 8)
print(ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Sample, y = Methylation, fill = Sample)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("sperm_r1" = "#45B7D1",
                               "sperm_r2" = "#96CEB4",
                               "E9epi_r1" = "#FF6B6B",
                               "E9te_r1" = "#4ECDC4")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Methylation Level"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 1))
dev.off()
```
